title: After 5 Years, Dandadan Finally Reveals Okarun’s Tragic Origin Story
content: DAN DA DAN has been working its way through one of its most divisive arcs for the past few months, and it has all led to the reveal of Okarun’s truly heartbreaking origin story after five long years.
author: ComicBook

title: Rock Band FLOW Announce U.S. Dates for New 2027 World Tour
content: Rock band FLOW announced last Friday U.S., Latin American, and Japanese dates for its new tour titled " FLOW WORLD TOUR 2027 "ONCE IN A CENTURY"～ ANIME THE MAX!!!" The tour features songs that FLOW have performed for anime as well as songs from ONCE IN A CENTURY , their first full original album in four years.
author: ANN

title: Exclusive: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Heads to HIDIVE in 2027, North American Premiere Set for December 5
content: HIDIVE will distribute Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery in 2027, with the film set to have its North American premiere on December 5 at Anime Frontier in Fort Worth, Texas. Further release details will be announced at a later date.
author: Anime Corner

title: Naruto’s Live-Action Movie Gets Surprising Change Amid DC Studios Shake Up
content: Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto is now in the works on a new live-action movie, and it’s gotten a surprising shake up due to everything now happening with DC Studios following the Warner Bros. and Paramount merger.
author: ComicBook

title: New Code Geass Anime Reveals New Look & Cast Ahead of 2027 Release
content: Code Geass is coming back next year with a brand new anime, and a new look has been revealed at the wild cast of new characters fans will see in action with this next generation of the franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: A Legendary Action Series Is Finally Getting an Anime After 14 Years – Watch First Look Trailer
content: A legendary action manga is finally getting its own official anime adaptation 14 years after its original debut, and the first look has been revealed at what to expect ahead of its big debut.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Quest RPG Mobile Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Launch, Closed Beta Test in December
content: The Dragon Quest franchise announced that Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle ( Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ), a new game for iOS and Android devices, will launch in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Confirms How Long It’s Going to Be
content: The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime now airing its episodes through the Fall, and a new update has revealed just how long Devils’ Crest is going to be sticking around for.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Streams Suikoden Anime
content: The series began streaming with English subtitles on YouTube for free beginning on October 6 with new episodes on Tuesdays. The stream is available in North America, Latin America, the Caribbean, Ireland, parts of Africa and the Middle East, and in New Zealand and Australia.
author: ANN

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Shows Off Its Stands With New Trailer – Watch
content: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run has been airing its new episodes through the Fall, and a special new trailer is showing off all of the cool new Stands that have made their debuts thus far.
author: ComicBook
